snippet.title: Clock Tower DEMO - PSX / PS1 - 16:9 Widescreen
snippet.description:
As featured on the ASCII Entertainment Demo CD (1997). Shrink your browser screen for better quality view. 

Only ten minutes given to explore through the Barrow's Mansion with Jennifer Simpson, the protagonist from Clock Tower: First Fear.
